messages:
maria: Hey team — ACME POC failing, 403 on /v1/generate with the trial key. Demo in ~2h, can someone triage?

 maria: Here is the failing curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_abc123' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

 maria: Response body: {"error":"Forbidden","message":"org mismatch: token org=org_789, request org=org_456" }

 devon: ugh, org mismatch — likely the trial key is bound to their sandbox org (org_789) but the demo code sets X-Redwood-Org: org_456. Can you confirm which org the customer is passing?

 maria: customer says they set the header to their project org_456 via env var. They pasted their app config earlier but maybe env var stale.

 ravi: quick checks:
- verify Authorization token (keys are org-bound). paste token into jwt.io or use `redwood keys inspect sk_trial_abc123` to see `org` claim.
- server-side libs sometimes rewrite headers; confirm whether a proxy or frontend library is adding X-Redwood-Org.

 ravi: if token org != expected org, two options: rotate key under the correct org or create a demo key bound to the request org. Removing X-Redwood-Org is a no-go for prod.

 sophie: short-term workaround: I can create a temporary demo key attached to org_456 and mark it demo-only. Maria, want me to spin one up? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

 maria: yes please, demo at 3pm. Also CS asked whether we can extend trial/quota for demos — pricing/approval?

 devon: we can grant 48-72h demo extensions without charging; >72h needs AM sign-off. I'll update CRM.

 sophie: creating demo key now...

 deploy-bot: [key.created] key id: sk_demo_zz9xx bound_org: org_456 created_by: sophie

 maria: got it, forwarding sk_demo_zz9xx to customer. I'll also send the note about token org binding and X-Redwood-Org header after the demo.

 ravi: FYI — intermittent 403s often caused by proxies/load-balancers stripping or rewriting headers (esp. X-Redwood-Org). Also watch for env var rotation in CI.

 maria: great, keeping this thread open. I'll report back after the demo. :white_check_mark:
